item.title: Kerala Budget 2026‑27: State Becomes India’s First to Provide Free Graduation Education and School Student Insurance
item.description: Kerala extends free education to undergraduate Arts and Science students while boosting welfare, scholarships, and research funding.

item.title: Real-Life Mardaani: IPS Officer Mallika Banerjee Rescues Children, Exposes Trafficking Networks Through Undercover Operation
item.description: An IPS officer’s undercover effort in Chhattisgarh exposed illegal placement agencies, rescued trafficked children, and highlighted India’s ongoing battle against child trafficking.

item.title: Budget 2026 Expectations for Education: Skills, Research and Digital Inclusion for Viksit Bharat
item.description: Budget 2026 aims to transform Indian education by prioritizing research innovation and bridging the digital divide.

item.title: Hyderabad Professor Converts 50 Tonnes of Plastic Waste Into Low-Cost Cleaner Fuel, Offering Hope for a Greener Future
item.description: A purpose-driven innovation by a Hyderabad professor shows how non-recyclable plastic can be transformed into low-cost fuel while tackling India’s growing waste crisis.

item.title: 29-Year-Old Dies from Monkey Fever in Karnataka: First KFD Fatality Signals Early Seasonal Surge
item.description: A 29-year-old man from Shivamogga dies from KFD, prompting heightened surveillance and public health alerts.

item.title: Kerala to Reduce Class 10 SSLC Syllabus by 25 Per Cent from 2026–27 Academic Year: Education Minister
item.description: Kerala trims the Class 10 syllabus by 25 per cent to reduce student stress and academic burden.

item.title: Logical Take: Health and Governance – Why India’s ‘Model State’ Debate Isn’t About One Winner
item.description: India has made major health gains over the last decade, but state-level governance still determines who survives, thrives, or struggles.

item.title: Commercial LPG Cylinder Prices Hiked By ₹49 On Budget Day; Domestic Rates Remain Stable
item.description: In a significant move ahead of the 2026 Budget, commercial LPG prices rose by ₹49 across India.
